# `get_dark_files`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

List the temperature dark library (firmware 9.75).

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | method (client sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER / READ |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.75, handler @0xfa890 (64-bit build); 32-bit build @0x5ed6c (parity INFERRED) |

New in firmware 9.75, app 3.4.0. Lists the folders (one per exposure) or the master-dark files of one folder in the temperature dark library. It does not use the image path. Params may be absent, a bare string or an object with a string name; any other type gives 105. The name selects the listing: empty or darklibrary lists folders (path darklibrary, list_type folder); darklibrary/<N>s with N in 1..2147483 lists the files of that folder (path is the full name, list_type file). Any other name, or a failure while building the listing, gives 207. An empty or unreadable directory gives files [] with success. The result carries path and list_type, and list is an array holding one element {group_name, files}; group_name is always empty. File entries are ordered by temperature (0.05 tolerance) and then by name; the order of folder entries (ascending exposure) is INFERRED.

Side effects: None.

Clients SHOULD use an integer or a string and SHOULD keep ids unique among outstanding requests. On early dispatcher errors (100, 200) the reply carries id null. [READ] |

| `params` | null\|string\|object | no | - | Optional. May be absent or null (root), a string (the name), or an object with an optional name. Other types, or a non-string name, give 105. [READ] |

## Errors

| Code | Trigger | Label |
|---|---|---|
| 105 | params is not absent, a string or an object, or name is not a string | `expected string` |
| 207 | name is not darklibrary or darklibrary/<N>s, or the listing could not be built | `invalid path` |
| 200 | Dispatcher: request has no id | `invalid id` |
| 100 | Dispatcher: method missing or not a string | `invalid request` |

An empty or missing directory is success with files [].

## Example

Request, request - root listing; READ shape, not captured:

```json
{"id":93,"method":"get_dark_files"}
```

Reply, ok - values invented:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","method":"get_dark_files","result":{"path":"darklibrary","list_type":"folder","list":[{"group_name":"","files":[{"name":"10s","thn":"","count":2,"type":0,"exposure_sec":10.0}]}]},"code":0,"id":93}
```
